# core/wtext.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/wtext.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

Text kept as a `Vec[u64]`, one character a word.

Programs that mix characters with other words in one vector (a
compiler's source and output buffers, say) keep text this way rather
than as the `Vec[u8]` of core/text.bastio. Every function here is total:
a span or position out of range is simply not a match, so callers need
no bounds facts of their own.

What is proved: appends keep what was there and add exactly the
characters written (`wtext_push_str`), or only decimal or hexadecimal
digits (`wtext_push_u64`, `wtext_push_hex`); a comparison returns true
exactly when the characters are equal (spec fns `wtext_is_str_at`,
`wtext_same_at`).

`import "core/wtext.bastio";`

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`wtext_push_str`](#wtext_push_str) | Appends the characters of `s`. |
| [`wtext_push_u64`](#wtext_push_u64) | Appends `x` in decimal, with no leading zeros. |
| [`wtext_push_hex`](#wtext_push_hex) | Appends `x` in lower-case hexadecimal, with no `0x`, padded with zeros to at least `min` digits (the value itself takes 1 to 16). |
| [`wtext_push_span`](#wtext_push_span) | Appends `src[from..to]` (the part of it in range). |
| [`wtext_push_all`](#wtext_push_all) | Appends all of `src`. |
| [`wtext_has_str_at`](#wtext_has_str_at) | `t` holds the characters of `s` from `at` (false if they would run past the end). |
| [`wtext_same`](#wtext_same) | `t[i..i+n]` and `t[j..j+n]` are in range and hold the same words. |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `wtext_push_str`

```bastio
fn wtext_push_str(t: &mut Vec[u64], s: Str)
  ensures vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + slen(s)
  ensures wtext_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures wtext_is_str_at(t, vlen(old(t)), s)
```

Appends the characters of `s`.

Example:

```bastio
let mut t = vec_new[u64]();
wtext_push_str(&mut t, "mov rax, ");
wtext_push_u64(&mut t, 42);
wtext_push_str(&mut t, " ; 0x");
wtext_push_hex(&mut t, 42, 4);
assert wtext_is_str_at(t, 0, "mov ");   // from the contracts alone
let ok = wtext_has_str_at(t, 9, "42 ; 0x002a") && vec_len(t) == 20;
vec_free(t);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `wtext_push_u64`

```bastio
fn wtext_push_u64(t: &mut Vec[u64], x: u64)
  ensures vlen(old(t)) < vlen(t) && vlen(t) <= vlen(old(t)) + 20
  ensures wtext_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures wtext_digits_from(t, vlen(old(t)))
```

Appends `x` in decimal, with no leading zeros: between 1 and 20 digits.

### `wtext_push_hex`

```bastio
fn wtext_push_hex(t: &mut Vec[u64], x: u64, min: u64)
  ensures vlen(old(t)) < vlen(t)
  ensures wtext_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures wtext_hex_from(t, vlen(old(t)))
```

Appends `x` in lower-case hexadecimal, with no `0x`, padded with zeros
to at least `min` digits (the value itself takes 1 to 16).

### `wtext_push_span`

```bastio
fn wtext_push_span(t: &mut Vec[u64], src: &Vec[u64], from: u64, to: u64)
  ensures wtext_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures from <= to && to <= vlen(src) ==> vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + (to - from)
  ensures from <= to && to <= vlen(src) ==> (forall k: u64 :: k < to - from ==> vget(t, vlen(old(t)) + k) == vget(src, from + k))
```

Appends `src[from..to]` (the part of it in range).

Example:

```bastio
let mut src = vec_new[u64]();
wtext_push_str(&mut src, "hello world");
let mut t = vec_new[u64]();
wtext_push_span(&mut t, src, 6, 11);
wtext_push_str(&mut t, ", ");
wtext_push_all(&mut t, src);
// "world, hello world": positions 0..5 and 13..18 hold the same words.
let ok = wtext_same(t, 0, 13, 5) && !wtext_same(t, 0, 7, 5) && !wtext_same(t, 15, 0, 5);
vec_free(t);
vec_free(src);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `wtext_push_all`

```bastio
fn wtext_push_all(t: &mut Vec[u64], src: &Vec[u64])
  ensures vlen(t) == vlen(old(t)) + vlen(src)
  ensures wtext_keeps(t, old(t), vlen(old(t)))
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < vlen(src) ==> vget(t, vlen(old(t)) + k) == vget(src, k)
```

Appends all of `src`.

### `wtext_has_str_at`

```bastio
fn wtext_has_str_at(t: &Vec[u64], at: u64, s: Str) -> bool
  ensures result == wtext_is_str_at(t, at, s)
```

`t` holds the characters of `s` from `at` (false if they would run
past the end).

### `wtext_same`

```bastio
fn wtext_same(t: &Vec[u64], i: u64, j: u64, n: u64) -> bool
  ensures result == wtext_same_at(t, i, j, n)
```

`t[i..i+n]` and `t[j..j+n]` are in range and hold the same words.

## Specification functions

### `wtext_is_str_at`

```bastio
spec fn wtext_is_str_at(t: &Vec[u64], at: u64, s: Str) -> bool {
  at <= vlen(t) && slen(s) <= vlen(t) - at
    && (forall k: u64 :: k < slen(s) ==> vget(t, at + k) == sget(s, k))
}
```

`t` from `at` holds the characters of `s`.

### `wtext_same_at`

```bastio
spec fn wtext_same_at(t: &Vec[u64], i: u64, j: u64, n: u64) -> bool {
  i <= vlen(t) && n <= vlen(t) - i && j <= vlen(t) && n <= vlen(t) - j
    && (forall p: u64 :: i <= p && p < i + n ==> vget(t, p) == vget(t, p - i + j))
}
```

`t[i..i+n]` and `t[j..j+n]` are in range and equal. (Stated over
positions `p` in the first span: with an offset into each, the proof
needs instances Z3 does not always find; see bytes_span_eq.)

### `wtext_keeps`

```bastio
spec fn wtext_keeps(t: &Vec[u64], u: &Vec[u64], n: u64) -> bool {
  n <= vlen(t) && n <= vlen(u) && (forall k: u64 :: k < n ==> vget(t, k) == vget(u, k))
}
```

The first `n` words of `t` are those of `u`.

### `wtext_digits_from`

```bastio
spec fn wtext_digits_from(t: &Vec[u64], from: u64) -> bool {
  forall k: u64 :: from <= k && k < vlen(t) ==> 48 <= vget(t, k) && vget(t, k) <= 57
}
```

Words `from..` of `t` are decimal digit characters.

### `wtext_hex_from`

```bastio
spec fn wtext_hex_from(t: &Vec[u64], from: u64) -> bool {
  forall k: u64 :: from <= k && k < vlen(t) ==>
    (48 <= vget(t, k) && vget(t, k) <= 57) || (97 <= vget(t, k) && vget(t, k) <= 102)
}
```

Words `from..` of `t` are lower-case hexadecimal digit characters.
